artworks.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II, after Hans von Aachen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman holding a sword aloft with one hand and a severed head by the hair in the other, while another figure kneels beside her. The tent backdrop features detailed drapery and tassels, and the scene is skillfully rendered in a monochromatic palette with sharp lines and shading. The figures have classical features, and the scene is framed by ornate script.

artworks.title: Allegory of the Marriage of Emperor Ferdinand II and Eleanor Gonzaga
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 34.7 x 23.9 cm (13 11/16 x 9 7/16 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: This is an image of an elaborate allegorical scene. It is a highly detailed engraving depicting a complex narrative through its figures and symbols. At the center of the image, a large reclining figure is intertwined with a donkey-like creature, surrounded by various other symbolic figures and objects. Above them, a cherubic figure stands on clouds holding scales in each hand. To the sides, ornately dressed figures accompany the central scene, some holding masks or theatrical attributes. In the upper part, cherubic figures ride on creatures resembling mythical beings. The scene is framed with cloud formations and rich textures. The lower part includes a book with an inscription in Latin. This engraving reflects a Baroque style in its dramatic intensity, intricate details, and allegorical themes.

artworks.title: Evening
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a banquet scene. The depiction shows a group gathered around a table with food and drink. One individual is pouring a drink while others interact. The textures of clothing, tablecloth, and drapery suggest luxury. In the background, there is a smaller scene with mythical figures. The line work and shading convey a sense of realism and drama, typical of Renaissance or Baroque art styles.

artworks.title: Night
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 21.2 x 15.1 cm (8 3/8 x 5 15/16 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: The image depicts three people in an indoor setting. In the foreground, a woman is shown in a seated position with her eyes closed and arms crossed over her chest. She has a headpiece covering her hair and wears a dress with a ruffled collar. Beside her, a cradle with a baby is visible, and there are decorative objects nearby, including pottery and a mask. In the background, a man is lying in a canopied bed, his upper body exposed, looking up at another woman who is leaning over him. This woman wears a detailed dress with lace details and may be holding an object in her hand. The setting appears to be a bedroom with a heavy curtain creating a canopy for the bed. There is a lit candle on a stand beside the bed and another lit candle on the floor next to a cat. The walls have framed artworks hanging, one depicting a landscape scene with sailing ships and figures.

artworks.title: Earth
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Dirck Barendsz
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.4 × 23.2 cm (6 7/8 × 9 1/8 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure seated, cloaked in flowing drapery, holding a staff. The landscape around them has hills, mountains, architectural structures, trees, and rocks. To the right, smaller figures appear engaged in labor near a cave.

artworks.title: Water
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Dirck Barendsz
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.1 × 22.6 cm (6 3/4 × 8 7/8 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure with a trident riding a horse in the sea. The figure holds a trident in the left hand and grips the horse's mane with the right hand. The horse is a blend of equine features and sea creature elements. The waves are depicted with dynamic lines, matching the movement of the horse and figure. The sky has swirling clouds, adding drama to the scene. The artwork is detailed with monochromatic shading, giving it a classical and timeless quality.

artworks.title: Fire
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Dirck Barendsz
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.8 × 22.8 cm (7 × 9 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding lightning bolts, seated on an eagle. The muscular figure is depicted in a dynamic pose. Lightning bolts are held in both hands. The eagle is depicted realistically with wings spread and sharp talons visible. The background features swirling patterns. An inscription is at the top and Latin text is at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion [Center Panel]
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Jacopo Tintoretto
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from four blocks in buff, light brown, gray, and red brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene. The image shows figures gathered at the base of the cross expressing grief and despair. The central figure is on the cross with an inscription above the head. Other figures in the foreground and background appear to be mourning or lamenting, with some looking towards the central figure. The use of sepia tones and dramatic contrasts adds to the emotional intensity of the scene. The painting is detailed, capturing a historical and religious theme with careful attention to the expressions and postures of the figures present.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion (Right Panel)
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Jacopo Tintoretto
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from four blocks in buff, light brown, gray, and red brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of knights and soldiers in a forest. Figures are depicted on horseback or standing, with interactions within the group. The attire and armor suggest a historical or mythological narrative. Horses are present, with some rearing back or being guided. Dense foliage from trees serves as a backdrop. Some distant figures seem to be observing or engaged in an activity. Shading and line work create a monochromatic texture that enhances form and movement in the scene.

artworks.title: Dives and Lazarus (Right Panel)
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Jacopo Bassano
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from four blocks in buff, brown, and two shades of gray on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 55.5 x 37.3 cm (21 7/8 x 14 11/16 in.) cut to image
artworks.description: This is a painting of an outdoor gathering scene. The image depicts a group of figures in a classical setting with architectural elements such as columns and arches. There is a large table covered with a cloth, laden with plates and a goblet. Surrounding the table are various figures engaged in conversation or other activities. Two dogs are at the foreground, one seated and the other looking upward. In the background, lush trees and a scenic view of a distant village can be seen, and an owl is perched above on the arch. The color palette is a blend of sepia tones. This is in the style of Titian.

artworks.title: Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple (Center Panel)
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from four blocks in umber, gray, and two shades of brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with people gathered on steps. The image shows an elaborate architectural facade with columns and steps. Several individuals are assembled on the steps, engaging in conversation and gestures. The architectural details are precise, displaying intricate column capitals and a clear division of space. The building in the background has people observing from balconies and windows. The scene is set outdoors, with a distant landscape on the left. The drawing is in brown and tan hues, giving it a sepia-toned appearance.

artworks.title: Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple (Right Panel)
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from four blocks in umber, gray, and two shades of brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals standing on a grand staircase leading to an architectural space with columns. The individuals are wearing robes. One figure seems to be gesturing or speaking. The scene includes intricate details like the capitals of the columns. There is a basket with eggs and a plaque with Latin inscription below.

artworks.title: Nude
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove buff paper
artworks.description: The image shows a linear drawing of a person in a minimalist style, displayed from the knees upward. The figure is depicted in a reclining position, potentially leaning against a vertical surface, with a focus on the torso, arms, and head. The face is abstract with prominent eyes and a small nose, and the hair is illustrated with sweeping lines indicating a bob style. The person is undressed, outlined with simple lines suggesting the form, with one arm extended downward. The background is basic, with minimal lines indicating a setting, against a textured backdrop resembling light brown paper.

artworks.title: Elbe Landscape Near Dresden
artworks.medium: graphite and crayon on wove cream paper
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract landscape with a body of water, distant land, and simplified human and architectural forms. The view is from a slightly elevated angle, with loose and fluid brushstrokes creating forms and motion. The color palette is soft and muted, with hints of green, yellow, red, and black against a pastel background. Closest to the viewer are water and boat-like shapes, while distant figures and structures suggest human activity. The overall effect is one of simplicity and minimalism, inviting the viewer to interpret the scene.

artworks.title: Landscape in the Taunus
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line cuts across the center, with abstract shapes representing foliage and terrain. The scene is sketched in loose graphite strokes, varying in thickness and direction. Curved lines suggest landforms with subtle impressions of figures and trees. The color palette is neutral with creamy paper and dark graphite lines.

artworks.title: Houses in Dresden with People Strolling
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with an architectural structure dominating the view. The horizon is unclear, and the structure's sharp lines and edges reach the top of the artwork. The drawing is done in a loose, gestural style with charcoal strokes outlining the building and figures. The color palette is monochromatic, using black on creamy paper. Figures are depicted walking or standing on a pathway, while the building's details are minimal, suggesting windows and rooflines. Other elements in the scene are abstracted for interpretation.

artworks.title: Goatherd with Goats
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and black ink on white board
artworks.description: The image shows a composition of dynamic, swirling lines and shapes, creating an abstract scene on the paper. Amidst the chaotic arrangement, certain lines form angles that could resemble rooftops, while others curl and swoop like branches. Subtle, vertical lines hint at figures or totems, and a few strokes suggest forms of an animal. The interplay of thick and thin lines throughout the piece produces layers, adding depth to the abstract impression conveyed by the artwork.

artworks.title: Two Bathers on the Fehmarn Coast (Zwei Badende am hoher Fehmarnküste)
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch from a slight aerial point of view. There is no horizon depicted. The composition includes figures and abstract forms representing vegetation and rocks, with two human-like figures—one closer to us and the other standing further in the distance. The brushstrokes are expressive and spontaneous, creating dynamic outlines and suggested shapes. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of black ink on a cream paper.

artworks.title: The Finger Game
artworks.dimensions:
image: 15 x 9 cm (5 7/8 x 3 9/16 in.)
sheet: 19 x 18 cm (7 1/2 x 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, with their head slightly tilted down and hands close to their chest. They have a stylized face with a calm expression, dark eyebrows, and dark, neatly styled hair in an updo. The person is unclothed and the image has an abstract and artistic style. The background has bold vertical lines and elongated ovals against a dark backdrop, with a floor featuring diagonal lines to create a sense of perspective.

artworks.title: Reclining Nude
artworks.description: The image shows a figure lying down on their back, with one arm extended towards the bottom right and legs extended to the left. The face features are simple, with dark hair flowing back. The figure is unclothed, with no identifiable clothing. In the background, there are circular shapes in the upper part of the image, and a relatively blank space below the figure. No objects or jewelry are visible on the person.

artworks.title: Einladung...Ausstellung der Kuenstlergruppe Brücke (Invitation to an Exhibition of the Artists' Group Brücke)
artworks.medium: color woodcut printed in brown ink
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an art exhibition invitation. The image features a bold, graphic composition with a contrast between dark and light colors. In the center are three abstract figures with elongated forms. Surrounding them are plant-like decorative motifs. The typography includes blocky, angular German letters inviting viewers to an exhibition by the "Kuenstlergruppe Brücke" (Artists' Group Bridge) at a specific location. The design reflects early 20th-century German art movements like German Expressionism.

artworks.title: Nude Girl
artworks.description: Printed with thick, bold outlines and areas of flat black against cream-white paper, a nude woman bends at the waist against what could be a bed in this stylized, square woodcut print. The woman’s form is loosely outlined so details are indistinct, but she seems to rest her face on one bent forearm, braced on the surface across which she lies. Her body bends at the hips so her toes brush the floor along the bottom edge of the print. Her eye, nose, and lips are boldly outlined and she has small breasts and her groin is delineated. Curving lines in the area around her suggests fabric or a bed. The background above her and the area below her face, along the right edge of the paper, are swallowed in blackness.

artworks.title: Shed on the Bank of the Elbe
artworks.description: The image shows a woodcut print of a wooden structure with figures below. The style features sharp black-and-white contrasts and angular lines. The horizon line is implied by the buildings meeting the sky. Two figures and a dog are depicted on a pathway leading to stairs. The stairs lead to additional structures. In the distance, there are more buildings and trees. The color palette is black against light-colored paper.
